title: lycopodium novoguineense
intro: Lycopodium novoguineense, commonly known as New Guinea Club Moss, is a plant species that belongs to the genus Lycopodium and is native to New Guinea. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Lycopodium novoguineense include its ability to reduce inflammation, relieve pain, and support the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, saponins, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
